player_prompt.intro:
A yi waɗe kuugal gal gal Minesweeper.
Kuugal ngal anndi e gootooji ɗuuɗe ɗe tawi cel ɗe mines.
Mbele a yi waɗe kuugal, a yi ɗaɗe row e col waɗe a yi sooda waɗe ɗe waɗe a yi waɗe:
- `[row col]`: Waɗe cel ɗe waɗe a yi sooda waɗe row e col.
Misal:
- `[3 2]` waɗe cel ɗe waɗe Row 3, Col 2.
- `[5 6]` waɗe cel ɗe waɗe Row 5, Col 6.
A yi waɗe kuugal fuu, a yi waɗe ɗeɗɗe ɗe cel ɗe a yi sooda waɗe a yi hawta safe start.
Kuugal ngal hawre ɗe waɗe ɗeɗɗe ɗe cel ɗe tawi e dot ('.'), waɗe ɗeɗɗe ɗe numbers ɗe waɗe ɗe mines ɗeɗɗe.
A yi hawta a yi waɗe cel ɗe tawi e waɗe.
Hawre ɗe kuugal ngal hawre:

invalid_move.wrong_format: A jaabake be ko hawtata nder dabareji je ɗon bana.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Koordinatiiri e ndeeri e ndeeji ɓaawo ɗuuɗe.

outcome.win: Koolaaɓe, on heɓii nasaraaku nder jaɓɓorgo Minesweeper.
outcome.turn_limit: Limgal waylugo yotti. A heɓti {percent}% nder cuuɗi je ɗon ɓilliije.
